South East Queensland Hauliers (SEQH) is a leading provider of transport, logistics, and warehousing solutions throughout Queensland.
Proudly family-owned and operated since the 1960s, SEQH has grown into one of Australia's largest import and export wharf carriers. With operations spanning Brisbane, Toowoomba, and the Port of Brisbane, we continue to invest in our people, our facilities, and our future.
About the Role
As a Professional Diesel Mechanic/Fitter, you will play a crucial role in fault diagnosis, repair and maintenance of company vehicles and equipment. Your responsibilities will vary depending on your experience level but may include:
•	Minimising plant and equipment downtime through proactive maintenance.
•	Diagnosing, inspecting, servicing, and repairing the fleet to ensure adherence to safety and quality standards.
•	Maintaining all company plant, equipment, and vehicles according to manufacturer's specifications.
•	Attending breakdowns and performing field-related mechanical repairs promptly.
•	Communicating safety or maintenance issues effectively and efficiently.
About You
•	3 years' experience as a Diesel Mechanic/Fitter.
•	Certification III in Heavy Machine Mechanic or Diesel Fitter
•	Strong technical skills and knowledge of diesel engine systems and components
•	Experience with Kone, Kalmar, Hyster, Sennebogen, Caterpillar preferred
•	Manual Licence essential
What We Offer
•	Competitive full-time rates up to $55 per hour, with overtime opportunities.
•	Enjoy a local, family-friendly Monday to Friday roster.
•	Join a supportive and collaborative work environment.
•	Access training opportunities to support professional development.
•	Benefit from weekly pay and competitive remuneration.
Why Join SEQH?
At SEQH, we believe great people come from all backgrounds. We hire for attitude and invest in training, development, and career growth.
If you're looking for more than just a job and want the opportunity to build a long-term career in a growing industry, we'd love to hear from you.
Applications can be submitted via Seek or email at IWantacareer@seqh.com.au.

Type: Full-time

Location: Rockingham WA 6168

About the Business
Heritage Sphere Pty Ltd T/A Imperial Indian Restaurant is a distinguished dining venue located at the Rockingham Foreshore, specialising in authentic Indian cuisine. Renowned for its vibrant ambiance and commitment to quality, the restaurant offers a wide array of traditional dishes including Butter Chicken, Garlic Naan, Prawn Madras, Malai Kofta, Dal Makhni, and Goat Curry, with many gluten-free options available. It prides itself on using fresh ingredients, exceptional service, and a welcoming environment that caters to both locals and tourists seeking a genuine taste of India. The business values culinary excellence, cultural heritage, and a supportive team culture where passion for food and hospitality drives a positive, collaborative workplace.
About the Position
The Chef plays a pivotal role in delivering high-quality Indian cuisine at Imperial Indian Restaurant. Reporting to management, this full-time position involves planning, organising, and overseeing the preparation and cooking of authentic dishes in a busy restaurant setting. The Chef ensures consistency in flavour, presentation, and food safety while contributing to menu development and kitchen efficiency, making them essential to maintaining the restaurant’s reputation for excellence and customer satisfaction.
Key Responsibilities
•	Planning menus, estimating food and labour costs, and ordering supplies to support efficient kitchen operations.
•	Preparing, seasoning, and cooking a variety of authentic Indian dishes, including curries, tandoori items, breads, and vegetarian options.
•	Monitoring the quality of dishes at all stages of preparation and presentation to uphold high standards.
•	Discussing food preparation issues with managers, kitchen staff, and waiting team to ensure smooth service.
•	Demonstrating cooking techniques and advising on procedures to support team development and consistency.
•	Maintaining cleanliness, hygiene, and food safety standards in line with regulatory requirements.
•	Managing kitchen inventory, minimising waste, and contributing to cost control measures.
Requirements
•	Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
•	Certificate III and IV in Kitchen Management, plus Diploma and Advanced Diploma in Hospitality Management.
•	Minimum 1 year of relevant experience.
•	Strong technical skills in Indian cuisine preparation, including mastery of spices, tandoor cooking, and regional dishes.
•	Excellent organisational and time-management abilities to handle a fast-paced kitchen environment.
•	Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.
•	Commitment to food safety, hygiene, and quality standards.
How to Apply
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

About the Business:
Unique Collision Pty Ltd is a reputable panel beating and collision repair business based in Huntingdale, Victoria, serving the greater Melbourne area. We specialise in comprehensive vehicle repair and restoration services, including insurance claims management, private work, full detailing, paintless dent removal, replacement vehicles, and free pick-up and delivery. Committed to delivering high-quality premium service, we pride ourselves on exceptional workmanship, customer satisfaction, and a supportive, team-oriented workplace culture where attention to detail and professionalism are valued.
About the Position:
As a Motor Mechanic at Unique Collision Pty Ltd, you will play a vital role in diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining vehicles to the highest standards following collision repairs and mechanical issues. This full-time position involves a broad scope of mechanical work to ensure vehicles are safe, reliable, and returned to customers in excellent condition, supporting the business’s commitment to premium service and operational efficiency in our busy collision repair workshop.
Key Responsibilities:
Diagnose mechanical and electrical faults in engines and vehicle components.
Dismantle and remove engine assemblies, transmissions, steering mechanisms, and other parts, inspecting and checking them for defects.
Repair and replace worn or defective parts, reassemble mechanical components, and refer to service manuals as required.
Perform vehicle paint preparation, mechanical repairs, and scheduled maintenance services such as oil changes and tune-ups.
Conduct final inspections, quality control checks, and testing of repaired vehicles to ensure proper performance and compliance with standards.
Dismantle and assemble vehicles as needed to support panel beating and collision repair processes.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Certificate III in relevant automotive or mechanical qualifications.
At least 2 years of industry experience as a Motor Mechanic.
Strong technical skills in diagnosing faults, mechanical repairs, electrical systems, and vehicle assembly/disassembly.
Excellent attention to detail, problem-solving abilities, and a commitment to high-quality workmanship.
Good interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively as part of a team in a fast-paced workshop environment.
How to Apply:
